exports.branchAt: branchAt(timeline, instantMs, options?) -> { branch, method: reflog|commit-graph|current|unknown, confidence, attribution, detached, reason }
exports.attributeHistoricalBranches: attributeHistoricalBranches(events, { timelines, commitBranches, options? }) -> { events (context.branch rewritten, payload.historicalBranch label), attributions }
exports.reattributeHistoricalBranches: Effect requiring ChildProcessSpawner: loads timelines for every worktree in the events plus extra paths, then attributes
exports.summarizeAttribution: per-branch counts by basis and method, plus how many moved from the collect-time branch

attributionOrder: live-capture: hook/command-capture events keep their branch (confidence 1)
scored-commit: identity.commitSha on a commit reachable from exactly one local branch (strong, 0.9)
linked-request: same requestId/generationId/sessionId as an attributed event (provisional, max 0.8)

branchAtMethods.reflog: HEAD reflog of that worktree; confidence 0.95; detached HEAD -> branch null, unassigned
branchAtMethods.commit-graph: nearest branch-reflog commit entry or branch-exclusive commit within 24h; provisional; 0.7 bracketed, 0.5 one side, 0.35 neighbours disagree
branchAtMethods.current: no HEAD reflog, instant after current branch tip; provisional 0.4

inventory.method: node:sqlite backup() copies in an owned temp dir via /Users/satan/bin/owned-temp-dir (cleaned, 2.4 MB); counts and date ranges only
inventory.conclusion: Every Cursor record on this host is from 2026-09-30 and all AI rows come from scratch demo repos. There is no month-old Cursor history here, so the look-back window on this machine is hours, not weeks.

limits: HEAD reflog retention: gc.reflogExpire default 90 days (30 days for unreachable entries). Older instants use provisional commit-graph evidence or stay unassigned.
Commit-graph evidence uses branch-exclusive commits and branch-reflog commit entries only. History shared with other branches and deleted branches give no evidence.
Cursor Auto mode: the local DB and ai-code-tracking.db record model 'default'. Only the usage CSV or dashboard names the real model.
Usage CSV rows have no workspace or request id, so they stay unassigned unless a local event shares a request or conversation id.
Composer rows keep only the latest model and usage per chat (B06). Retroactive totals are only as complete as what Cursor kept.
Linked worktrees need their own worktree path in the event. A global row without a path is not guessed.
